headline_item.title_zh: 软银曾探讨收购海力士未果
headline_item.title_en: Sources: Masayoshi Son recently explored a possible $1T buyout of SK Hynix; SoftBank says the deal is "no longer under active consideration" (The Information)
headline_item.event_summary_zh: 软银集团创始人孙正义近期曾就收购SK海力士进行融资接触，但软银官方回应称目前已搁置该项计划
headline_item.event_summary_en: SoftBank Group CEO Masayoshi Son recently engaged with Wall Street institutions to explore a potential $1 trillion acquisition of SK Hynix. Although SK Hynix is a critical supplier in the HBM market, SoftBank subsequently confirmed that the deal is no longer under active consideration.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】软银集团首席执行官孙正义；SK海力士在华尔街金融机构：探讨约1万亿美元的并购可行性与融资方案，目前已叫停
【起因与机理】旨在布局AI全产业链核心硬件壁垒，尤其是在高带宽内存领域获取垄断性优势
【关键数据与实测】涉及融资规模高达1万亿美元。
【各方立场与态度】软银官方确认交易已终止，不再进行活跃评估。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] Masayoshi Son, SoftBank CEO; SK Hynix (Wall Street financial institutions): Explored a $1T buyout, now terminated
[Root Cause & Mechanism] Strategic goal to control AI hardware supply chain, specifically HBM dominance
[Key Metrics] Proposed deal size reached approximately $1 trillion.
[Official Stance & Demand] SoftBank confirmed deal termination and current inactive status.
headline_item.industry_impact_zh: 此举显示软银试图通过直接控股存内计算核心环节以锁定AI算力基础设施的瓶颈资产。万亿美元规模的并购设想若非因估值溢价或反垄断审查阻滞，足以重塑半导体供应链，其叫停反映了AI基础设施资产评估在宏观资本波动下的极高不确定性。
headline_item.industry_impact_en: This move signals SoftBank's attempt to control critical bottlenecks in AI infrastructure via vertical integration of high-bandwidth memory. The scale of the proposal suggests an ambitious bid to reshape the semiconductor supply chain; its termination underscores the extreme valuation volatility and regulatory complexity facing AI-adjacent hardware assets.

headlines.title_zh: 美国联邦调查局数据库遭入侵
headlines.title_en: Sources: the FBI is investigating an apparent breach of its NCIC database, which is used by law enforcement to share info on warrants and background checks (Evan Perez/CNN)
headlines.event_summary_zh: FBI正调查NCIC数据库入侵事件，该系统负责全美执法机构的逮捕令和背景审查信息共享
headlines.event_summary_en: The Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) is investigating a breach of its National Crime Information Center (NCIC) database. This system serves as a central hub for federal, state, and local law enforcement to share warrants and background check information, triggering intense scrutiny over the nation's critical infrastructure defense capabilities.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】美国联邦调查局（FBI）；局长卡什·帕特尔（Kash Patel）在全国犯罪信息中心（NCIC）数据库系统：正在调查一起严重的数据库入侵事件
【起因与机理】作为执法部门信息共享核心，系统安全性的丧失威胁到全美司法与执法联动效能
【调查与监管诉求】FBI NCIC执法数据库发生严重安全入侵。
【各方立场与态度】此前已发生过针对FBI招聘网站及纽约分局案件库的泄露事件。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] FBI; FBI Director Kash Patel (NCIC database system): Investigating a serious system intrusion
[Root Cause & Mechanism] As a central hub for law enforcement, its compromise threatens judicial and operational coordination nationwide
[Regulatory & Investigation Focus] FBI NCIC law enforcement database suffered a major intrusion.
[Key Position & Outlook] Preceded by previous leaks targeting FBI hiring sites and field office case files.
headlines.industry_impact_zh: 作为美国执法体系的底层数字骨干，NCIC多次遭到入侵暴露出关键基础设施在横向权限管理与威胁检测上的严重短板。此类针对执法核心数据库的渗透，不仅是单纯的数据泄露，更可能造成司法流程干扰与针对执法人员的信息对抗危机。
headlines.industry_impact_en: As the digital backbone of the U.S. law enforcement system, repeated intrusions into the NCIC reveal critical weaknesses in lateral access management and threat detection. Such penetration of core databases transcends simple data theft, risking disruption to judicial processes and operational security for law enforcement personnel.

headlines.title_zh: 纳斯达克100指数单周跌逾10%创六年新低
headlines.title_en: US tech stocks plunge into bear market in worst week since Covid-19 crisis
headlines.event_summary_zh: 纳斯达克100指数周五收跌5.6%，全周累计跌幅达10.4%，创下自2018年以来的最差周度表现
headlines.event_summary_en: The Nasdaq 100 index fell 5.6% on Friday, bringing the total weekly decline to 10.4%, marking its worst weekly performance in over six years. This volatility was driven by significant sell-offs in leading AI infrastructure and model firms like NVIDIA and Anthropic, reflecting a shift in investor sentiment regarding the translation of heavy AI capital expenditures into sustainable corporate earnings.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】纳斯达克100指数成分股（含英伟达、Anthropic）在美国资本市场交易环境：周五单日跌幅5.6%，全周累计跌幅10.4%
【起因与机理】AI投资回报率预期下滑引发的市场估值重估
【关键数据与实测】纳斯达克100指数周跌幅达10.4%。
【各方立场与态度】市场关注点聚焦AI产业投资回报率预期的重新定价。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] Nasdaq 100 constituent stocks (including NVIDIA and Anthropic): 5.6% daily decline and 10.4% cumulative weekly loss
[Root Cause & Mechanism] Correction of investor expectations for AI ROI and valuation concerns
[Key Metrics] 10.4% cumulative weekly decline for the index.
[Key Position & Outlook] Market focus shifts to re-evaluating the ROI of AI capital expenditures.
headlines.industry_impact_zh: 此轮科技股暴跌标志着市场已从单纯的“技术叙事驱动”转向“财务约束验证期”，资本支出强度与边际产出的剪刀差已成为市场审视AI资产的核心逻辑。随着英伟达等核心算力龙头的估值回归，AI基础设施市场的博弈点将从模型参数规模竞争转向推理成本的边际经济性与垂直应用场景的商业闭环能力。
headlines.industry_impact_en: This sell-off signals a transition from narrative-driven optimism to financial validation, where the gap between CAPEX intensity and marginal output becomes the primary metric. With key incumbents facing valuation pressure, market focus will shift from parameter-count arms races to the economic viability of AI inference and the speed of commercial closure in vertical enterprise software.

titans.name: Yann LeCun
titans.role_zh: Meta 首席AI科学家 / 深度学习三巨头 / 图灵奖得主
titans.event_context_zh:
纳偏差：它们比其他函数更喜欢生成某些函数。

正则化器只是强加了另一种偏差。

学习理论告诉你，你必须有归纳偏差，否则你无法通过合理数量的样本或试验学到任何东西（VC理论，没有免费的午餐定理）。

所以，从概念上、理论上、哲学上和实践上来说，正则化器都没有问题。
titans.event_context_en: @int_16h @torchedvision @MuzafferKal_ @mengyer @yingwww_ @choang333 @KuangYilun Regularizers are just a way to specify a
titans.quote_zh:
@int_16h @torchedvision @MuzafferKal_ @mengyer @yingwww_ @choang333 @KuangYilun 正则化器只是指定归纳偏差的一种方法。

您的模型架构和您使用的优化过程已经存在归纳偏差：它们比其他函数更喜欢生成某些函数。

正则化器只是强加了另一种偏差。

学习理论告诉你，你必须有归纳偏差，否则你无法通过合理数量的样本或试验学到任何东西（VC理论，没有免费的午餐定理）。

所以，从概念上、理论上、哲学上和实践上来说，正则化器都没有问题。
titans.quote_en:
@int_16h @torchedvision @MuzafferKal_ @mengyer @yingwww_ @choang333 @KuangYilun Regularizers are just a way to specify an inductive bias.

The architecture of your model, and the optimization procedure you use already have inductive biases: they like to produce certain functions more than others.

A regularizer merely imposes another bias.

Learning theory tells you that you have to have an inductive bias, otherwise you can't learn anything with a reasonable number of samples or trials (VC theory, no free lunch theorems).

So, conceptually, theoretically, philosophically, and practically, there is nothing wrong with regularizers.
